runs.text: Read 6 marks and show the position, from 0 to 5, of the first mark less than 6. If there is none, show -1.

hints.text: Which way of solving is this: counting, searching, filtering? When can you stop looking?
Look at the table of shapes in
and change it only if you find one.
Start the position at -1; walk through and, at the first mark less than 6, keep the position and exit. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Show the position of the last mark less than 6. What changes in the walk?
Hidden cases: the first one in position 0, the last one in 5 and all failing (0 wins). Frequent mistake: not exiting the loop, which returns the last one and not the first.
